content: W3C WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 sets 24x24 CSS px minimum pointer target OR defined nonintersection spacing exception; W3C explicitly says larger targets improve ease and advises stricter 44x44 enhanced target for important controls. High-confidence current official standard (updated 2026-11-02), corroborated by web.dev practical mobile recommendation ~48 device-independent px with ~8px separation. For kid-first mobile UI, treat 44-48px as target for primary controls, not merely the AA floor.
